$comment: Built on SIP — Starlight Model Arena run receipt. Schema: arena-run v0.1.
method: Same prompt dispatched to two subagents with per-agent model override; objective tasks self-verify (asserts / ground truth); subjective tasks scored by a blind non-contestant judge (sonnet) with shuffled A/B labels.

tasks.verification: ground-truth answer + blind judge on output discipline

fable.notes: Clean table + tight justification, exactly as instructed.

opus.notes: Correct, but leaked stream-of-consciousness ('wait —') into final output, violating 'output ONLY' instruction.

tasks.verification: agent ran asserts via python; ALL PASS required
three ground-truth answers from CLAUDE.md (governance command, board-before-tag timing/version, recovery exception)
blind judge on voice fit + harness word-count check

opus.notes: Judge preferred prose style; exceeded 130-word hard limit by 18 words.

tasks.winner: split — judge: opus on style; harness: fable on constraint compliance

summary.headline: Correctness parity across reasoning, coding, and grounding. Fable 5's measurable edge is instruction compliance / output discipline: it was the only model that respected output-format and length constraints in both judged tasks.
caveats: n=1 per task — directional, not statistical.
Judge is a Claude-family model (sonnet); blind shuffled labels mitigate but do not eliminate family bias.
Both contestants run inside the Claude Code agent harness; results measure model-in-harness, not raw API behavior.
Latency includes harness overhead; treat durations as rough.
